storage: git-versioned keyed JSON datacore/cpc/degree_days.json — WHOLE-FILE REBUILD per run (each yearly source file re-serves its full year; git history keeps vintages), NOT append-only
written_by: scripts/cpc_degree_days.py (Python, session-run ~weekly; never on Railway — see cot.json _note on envelope-test coverage of Python writers)
source: NOAA CPC population-weighted daily degree days, StatesCONUS files (ftp.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov degree_days/weighted/daily_data/<year>/; probed keyless 2026-07-05)
license: US government work, public domain; attribution 'NOAA Climate Prediction Center'

field_map.axes.H / axes.C: shared daily date axes per kind (sorted, deduped across years)
field_map.series.<STATE|H> / series.<STATE|C>: daily heating/cooling degree days aligned to the kind's axis; non-numeric source cells are null, NEVER zero; short rows pad with null
field_map.selection: StatesCONUS Heating+Cooling 2016->current ONLY — census-division and fuel-weighted upstream variants deliberately not archived in v1

confidence_model: RAW official daily values, population-weighted by CPC. Format changes (missing Region header, non-YYYYMMDD date columns) refuse the file rather than guessing; only 2-char state codes are treated as states.
started: 2026-07-05 (history to 2016-01-01 captured in the first build)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). BUILD ORDER 3 #3; hypothesis (degree-day departures lead natgas/power demand and utility earnings surprises) stays gate-locked — archive only.
